milite.configuration.almostUnifiedIntegr: Enable the Almost Unified integration, if present.
milite.configuration.armorHudYPosition.t: Space between the top of the screen and the jetpack/GraviChestPlate overlay text.
milite.configuration.barrelContentRender: Enable rendering of barrel content: item icon, item amount, and item name.
milite.configuration.compostableToPlantO: Generate plant oil recipes in the centrifuge for all compostable items.
milite.configuration.datagenOnStartup.to: Run MI runtime datagen on startup.
milite.configuration.debugCommands.toolt: Enable UNSUPPORTED and DANGEROUS debug commands.
milite.configuration.defaultIndustrialis: Enable the default trades from the Industrialist villager provided by MI. Disable this to provide your own set of trades.
milite.configuration.defaultOreGenToolti: Enable the default ore generation tooltips. These tooltips show how each MI ore generates, based on the default ore generation settings in MI. Set this to false if you change the ore features in a datapack.
milite.configuration.ftbQuestsIntegratio: Enable the FTB Quests integration, if present.
milite.configuration.fuelTooltips.toolti: Add the total EU value of fuel items to their tooltips.
milite.configuration.hatchPlacementOverl: Show valid hatch positions in multiblocks when holding a hatch.
milite.configuration.interMachineConnect: Enable connected textures between machines that have the same casing. (Requires a suitable resource pack)
milite.configuration.itemTagTooltips.too: Add item tags to item tooltips.
milite.configuration.maxDistillationTowe: Maximum height of the distillation tower multiblock.
milite.configuration.maxMultiblockHighli: Show valid positions in multiblocks when holding a hatch or wrench while within this many blocks. Set to 0 to disable.
milite.configuration.missingRecipeViewer: Enable login message when EMI, JEI and REI are all missing.
milite.configuration.respawnWithGuideBoo: Grant guidebook when a player respawns after death.
Grant guidebook the first time a player joins the server.
milite.configuration.stonecutterToCuttin: Generate cutting machine recipes for all stonecutter recipes.
milite.configuration.transactionCallerNa: Enable to have transfer transactions include the name of the class that called it. Note that this comes at the cost of performance. It is recommended to not use this outside of debugging.
milite.configuration.validateRecipeLevel: On datapack load, check every machine recipe against the levels the machines of its type can reach, and log the ones nothing can craft. This only ever logs a warning, it never changes or removes a recipe. Turn it off if the checks get in the way.
text.autoconfig.milite.title: Modern Industrialization Menu
text.milite.AcceptAnyFluidFuels: Consumes any Fluid Fuel (Check REI for RF/mb production)
text.milite.AcceptAnyItemFuels: Consumes any Furnace Fuel (Check Item tooltip for RF production)
text.milite.AcceptsMachineHull: Change machine hull to connect higher tier cables.
text.milite.BatteryInStorageUnit: Insert in a Portable Storage Unit to add %s of capacity
text.milite.ConfigCardApplied: Applied pipe settings from Config Card
text.milite.ConfigCardHelpCamouflage2: - Press %s + %s on a block in the world to select it as camouflage.
text.milite.ConfigCardHelpCamouflage3: - Use %s on a pipe to update its camouflage.
text.milite.ConfigCardHelpCamouflage4: - Press %s + %s with a Wrench to remove the camouflage.
text.milite.ConfigCardHelpCamouflage5: - Use %s + %s to toggle transparent rendering of camouflage.
text.milite.ConfigCardHelpPipes2: - Press %s + %s on an item or fluid pipe connection to save its settings in the card.
text.milite.ConfigCardHelpPipes3: - Use %s on an item or fluid pipe connection to apply the settings from the card.
text.milite.ConfigCardSet: Copied pipe settings to Config Card
text.milite.ConfigCardWrongType: Saved config is not for this kind of pipe.
text.milite.ContinuousOperation: Maximum efficiency reached only under continuous operation
text.milite.DieselToolFuelHelp1: - Press %s on a tank to fill or empty. Any fluid fuel can be used.
text.milite.DieselToolFuelHelp2: - Speed of the tool is determined by the RF/mb of the fuel.
text.milite.DieselToolToggle: - Press %s + %s to swap between Fortune and Silk Touch.
text.milite.EbfMaxRF: Allows EBF recipes up to %d RF/t
text.milite.FluidSlotIO: Fluid IO, Left Click to Insert or Extract
text.milite.FluidSlotInput: Fluid Input, Left Click to Insert or Extract
text.milite.FluidSlotOutput: Fluid Output, Left Click to Extract
text.milite.FuelEfficiencyFluid: Accepts fluid fuel at %s efficiency! (RF %s per mb used)
text.milite.FuelEfficiencyFluidNormal: Accepts fluid fuel at normal efficiency.
text.milite.FuelEfficiencyItem: Accepts item fuel at %s efficiency! (RF %s per item used)
text.milite.FuelEfficiencyItemNormal: Accepts item fuel at normal efficiency.
text.milite.GunpowderUpgrade: Double MI Steam Machines speed for 2 minutes
text.milite.GunpowderUpgradeMachine: Use Gunpowder to double this machine speed for 2 minutes
text.milite.HasBetterYieldAssemblerRecip: Has an Assembler recipe with better yield.
text.milite.LargeTankTooltips: Stores %s buckets of fluid per block in the structure
text.milite.MachineMultipleRecipes1: The inputs match more than one possible recipe.
text.milite.MachineMultipleRecipes2: Lock all output slots with at least one locked to the desired output.
text.milite.MaxEuProductionSteam: Can produce up to %s worth of %s
text.milite.NetworkFluidHelpClear: Shift-click to clear the network of its fluid.
text.milite.NetworkFluidHelpSet: Click with a container to set the fluid for the network.
text.milite.NoEmi: WARNING: To play with Modern Industrialization, we STRONGLY RECOMMEND using EMI (Item and Recipe Viewer). Otherwise you won't be able to view the recipes in-game, and you will not be able to deal with conflicting machine recipes. Just Enough Items and Roughly Enough Items are also supported. This message can be disabled in the config.
text.milite.NoLargeTank: Not linked to a Large Tank
text.milite.OreNotGenerated: Not Generated but can be obtained with the Quarry
text.milite.OverclockMachine: Use %s to %fx this machine speed for %d ticks
text.milite.OverdriveModuleDescription1: Prevents electric machine efficiency from going down, at the cost of electricity.
text.milite.OverdriveModuleDescription2: The recipe will be locked until the module is removed or the machine runs out of power.
text.milite.PipeHelp1: Can be instantly retrieved by pressing %s + %s with any Wrench.
text.milite.PipeHelp2: Use %s + %s to connect directly the pipe to the target block.
text.milite.PriorityItemHelp: Items only move from lower extract (%s) priorities to equal or higher insert (%s) priorities. Greater differences take precedence.
text.milite.PriorityTransferHelp: Pipes will interact with higher priorities first.
text.milite.PutMotorToUpgrade: Put any Motor here to improve Item Pipe Speed
text.milite.RedstoneControlModuleHelp: Insert in a machine to enable redstone control.
text.milite.RequiresSteelHatch1: - Requires at least one Steel Hatch (Any)
text.milite.ShapeSelectionDescription: Click to open shape selection panel.
text.milite.SteamDrillFuelHelp: - Place fuel inside the drill using %s.
text.milite.SteamDrillWaterHelp: - Press %s on still or flowing water to fill.
text.milite.SuperconductorPowerOnly: Can only connect to Superconductor cables and machines. Must be directly connected to a machine on at least one end of the tunnel.
